blind.description: A small dark metallic chalice or goblet. It features a circular flanged foot base, a short stem with a central spherical knop, and a bell-shaped cup encircled by subtle horizontal bands. The interior of the cup is filled to near the rim with a dark red liquid (resembling wine). The metal has a dark aged pewter or tarnished silver finish with realistic specular highlights. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and properly structured, resting flat on its base.
blind.from_above: A circular dark metallic rim enclosing a pool of dark red liquid, casting an elongated shadow towards the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/8 to 1/10 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7–8 inches tall) and about 3–4 inches wide at the rim and base.
